name: Strangling Prison
description: Fire a massive vine cluster that pulls nearby enemies to its center and Imprisons them.

stats.CASTING: Single-cast projectile with a downward delay that creates a spell field upon impact
stats.DAMAGE: The projectile deals 10 damage, while the spell field deals 70 damage. While imprisoning enemies, it deals 20 damage every 0.5s

name: Spore Bomb
description: Throw an explosive Spore Bomb that splits into multiple small explosive spores.

stats.CASTING: Single-cast projectile with a downward delay that creates a spell field upon impact
stats.DAMAGE: The projectile itself deals no damage, while Spore Bomb deals 55 damage and explosive spores deal 10 damage
stats.RANGE: Spore Bomb generates a spell field with a 5m spherical radius, while small explosive spores create a spell field with a 1.5m spherical radius

name: Thornlash Wall
description: Target a location and grow a Thornlash Wall. When Awakened, it strikes nearby enemies attacked by Groot and his allies.

name: Ironwood Wall
description: Target a location and grow an Ironwood Wall. When the wall is Awakened, damage dealt by Groot and nearby allies grants Groot Bonus Health. Groot gains Unstoppable while near Ironwood Walls.

stats.HEALING: 40 bonus health per second, up to 250

name: Furious Flora
description: Perform a combo with his arms, and the third strike will slightly Launch Up the hit enemy airborne.

stats.RANGE: The first two strikes can reach 3m, while the third strike can reach 4m.

name: Flora Colossus
description: Wooden walls near Groot will Awaken, activating an extra effect. Right-click while building a wooden wall to continue building additional walls.

stats.CASTING: Persistent spell field that surrounds the caster
stats.RANGE: A cylindrical spell field with a 20m radius and a height of 40m

name: Friendly Shoulder
description: Jeff the Land Shark and Rocket Raccoon can ride on Groot's shoulders, receiving Damage Reduction.

name: Wild Wall
description: Mantis enhances Groot's wooden walls and Loki's Rune Stones with life energy. Groot can additionally unleash a Wild Wall, which, when in Flora Colossus state, restores health to random nearby allies and grants them Damage Reduction. Loki's Rune Stones grant allies within Regeneration Domain a Damage Boost.
